profile: Nurse, 34, Dutch, follows five or six series at once and forgets where she was in each.
goal: Sign in, open Up next and mark the next episode of a show as watched, then check that Up next moved on to the episode after it.

profile: Engineer, 41, German, careful with his privacy: refuses every permission an app asks for, uses large text and dark mode on an old small phone.
goal: Sign in, see which episodes air this week in the Calendar, and find out what the app does when he says no to notifications.

profile: Film student, 23, French, watches mostly movies, rates everything, taps fast and skips texts.
goal: Sign in, search for a movie she has not seen, add it to her watchlist, then mark another movie as watched and rate it.

profile: Retired nurse, 74, English, low vision, uses Android's largest font size (200%).
goal: Sign in, read every screen she opens without zooming, and open the details of a show to see which episode comes next.

profile: Teacher, 47, Spanish, uses the family tablet in the evening to pick something to watch.
goal: Sign in, use Discover and Surprise me to find something new, and judge whether the layout uses the big screen well.

profile: Bartender, 29, Italian, anime fan, likes to customise every app.
goal: Sign in, look at his watch stats on the profile, then change the bottom bar and the colours in Settings and check the change sticks after leaving and reopening the app.

profile: Retail manager, 52, British, new to SIMKL, wants to know what the app is before trusting it with an account.
goal: Understand from the first screens what the app does and why it needs a SIMKL account, sign in, and find out how to sign out again.

profile: Bookkeeper, 38, Belgian (Dutch-speaking), careful with money, tried many free tracker apps and only pays when he clearly sees what he gets.
goal: Use the free version (see 'Free-version testers' in the brief): find out what is free and what needs Watchlist Plus, open the locked Up next and Calendar, then open the subscription screen and judge whether the price, the free trial and how to cancel are clear before paying.

profile: Marketing assistant, 27, American, impatient with apps that nag her to pay, closes anything that feels pushy.
goal: Use the free version (see 'Free-version testers' in the brief) the way a new user would for a while: add a show, mark an episode, look at the profile. Judge every place the app asks her to pay: is it clear, honest and not pushy, and does the free version still feel useful?

profile: Pharmacist, 36, German, has used SIMKL's own official app for years and knows its screens by heart; skeptical that a third-party app does it better.
goal: Sign in and compare with SIMKL's official app: are her Watching, Plan to watch and Completed lists where she expects them, does marking an episode watched work the way SIMKL's app does, and what does this app offer that the official one doesn't?

profile: Barista, 26, American, watches everything through Stremio with SIMKL sync, mostly anime and series; never marks episodes by hand because Stremio does it for him.
goal: Sign in and check whether the app shows what Stremio already synced to SIMKL: what he is watching (the Watching tab), what is up next, and his anime. Judge whether the app is worth having next to Stremio when he rarely marks anything himself.

profile: Sound engineer, 44, Italian, runs Kodi on a home-theatre PC with the SIMKL scrobbler, often stops a movie halfway and finishes it another evening.
goal: Sign in and look for where movies and episodes she paused in Kodi would show up (Movies may have a Continue watching tab only when SIMKL has paused movies; the test account may have none). Judge whether it is clear how paused progress and Kodi's scrobbling fit into the app.

profile: Developer, 39, French, long-time trakt.tv user who is unhappy with Trakt's recent changes and is considering moving to SIMKL; knows Trakt's Up next, calendar and stats well.
goal: Sign in and judge whether this app plus SIMKL could replace Trakt for him: Up next, the Watching list, the Calendar, stats and ratings. Note what he misses from Trakt and whether the app explains anything about moving over.
